children: Smart Sand entered into Amendment No. 2 to its Credit Agreement, expanding its senior secured asset-based revolving credit facility by $20 million to $50 million and extending the term to September 1, 2031. The amendment adds a $20 million borrowing base sublimit tied to the value of the Oakdale, Wisconsin facility and includes a related minimum excess liquidity test when utilized. The company also agreed to a negative pledge on the Oakdale real property and adjustments to thresholds, including a $20 million deduct for unfinanced capital expenditures in the fixed charge coverage ratio. Management expects the changes to enhance liquidity and financial flexibility.
: Amendment to senior secured asset-based revolving credit facility
: First Citizens Bank & Trust Company, as agent and sole lender
: Increase liquidity and extend debt maturity
